landingPage.title: Welcome to the Questionnaire
landingPage.description: This questionnaire gathers your opinions on the warmth of guitar audio. In each trial, you'll listen to a set of audio clips and select the clips you perceive as having the most warmth and the most cold per section.

steps.listen: Listen: Play each of the provided audio clips.
steps.select: Select: Identify the audio clips with the most warmth and the most cold in each trial.
steps.submit: Submit: Confirm your selections and proceed to the next trial.

landingPage.finalNote: This study is conducted as part of my senior project at FIBO KMUTT and is exclusively for research purposes.
landingPage.nameError: Please enter your name to continue.
landingPage.consentText: I consent to the collection and use of my data for research purposes.

questionnaire.resultsMessage: Here are the final rankings of the stimuli based on your selections:
questionnaire.selectBoth: Please select both the Most Warmth and the Most Cold.
questionnaire.sameSelection: Most Warmth and Most Cold cannot be the same!

similarityAssessment.title: Audio Similarity Assessment
similarityAssessment.description: This questionnaire assesses how similar each guitar clip sounds compared to the original recording. In each trial, you'll hear several versions of the same guitar passage processed by different models. Your task is to rate each clip's resemblance to the hidden reference.

listen.title: 1. Listen
listen.instruction1: Click the ▶ button beside each clip to play it.
listen.instruction2: Feel free to replay as often as needed to judge similarity.

rate.title: 2. Rate
rate.instruction: Use the slider under each clip to indicate similarity to the reference:
rate.scale: 0 = Not Similar at All | 50 = Moderately Similar | 100 = Indistinguishable from Reference
rate.note1: The true reference (original) is included but cannot be rated.
rate.note2: A low‐quality anchor is hidden among the clips to help anchor your judgments.

submit.title: 3. Submit
submit.instruction1: After rating all clips in the set, click Submit to move on.
submit.instruction2: You'll then proceed to the next trial with a new guitar excerpt.
